derivedBy: hand, from the stated dimensions in lying-beam.design.md; never regenerated from napkin's output

overall.derivation: The extreme corners of every box, worked out in inches then x1024.

boxes.name: Beam, along X
boxes.derivation: Lying flat along X: 36" across X, 3 1/2" up Y, 1 1/2" thick (its depth). Occupies x 0..36, y 0..3 1/2, z 0..1 1/2.

boxes.name: Beam, along Y
boxes.derivation: The same box spun 90 degrees about its anchor at x = 43 1/2: local X (36") runs up Y and local Y (3 1/2") runs to -X, so it occupies x 40..43 1/2, y 0..36, z 0..1 1/2.

boxes.name: Beam, upright
boxes.derivation: Standing on end: 3 1/2" across X, 1 1/2" up Y, 36" tall (its depth). Occupies x 50..53 1/2, y 0..1 1/2, z 0..36.

boxes.name: Beam, on its side
boxes.derivation: Tipped onto an edge (face up = north): local Y (3 1/2") points up and local Z (1 1/2") points to -Y, so from the anchor at y = 10 it occupies x 0..36, y 8 1/2..10, z 0..3 1/2.

cutList.label: Beam
cutList.derivation: One 36" x 3 1/2" x 1 1/2" piece lying along X, lying along Y, standing up and tipped on its edge: however it is turned, it is the same piece, so four boxes are one row of 4 (36864 x 3584 x 1536 units). Label: the four names share "Beam, " -> "Beam".
